name: Innkeeper Gryshka
summary: At the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar, Innkeeper Gryshka welcomes travelers with food, drink, and a hearthstone binding. She keeps the inn supplied with meat from hunters across Durotar and the Barrens.

sections.title: Hearth of the Valley of Strength
sections.body: Innkeeper Gryshka welcomes travelers at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. The inn stands just beyond the city's main gates, where warriors, messengers, and newcomers to Thrall's Horde can find shelter.

sections.title: A Taste for Fresh Meat
sections.body: Gryshka keeps the Broken Tusk's kitchen supplied with fresh meat. Trusted hunters across Horde lands send her game, including Zargh at the Crossroads and Grimtak in Durotar, who ship their finest cuts to the inn.

faq.answer: Innkeeper Gryshka welcomes Horde travelers at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. She binds hearthstones and sells food and drink.

faq.q: Where can Innkeeper Gryshka be found?
faq.answer: You can find Innkeeper Gryshka inside the Broken Tusk in the Valley of Strength, the first major district beyond Orgrimmar's main southern gates.

faq.q: Where does Gryshka get her meat supplies?
faq.answer: Gryshka gets meat from hunters across Horde lands, including Zargh at the Crossroads in the Barrens and Grimtak in Durotar, who send her game cuts.

aliases: can i bind my hearthstone here
faq.answer: Gryshka can bind your hearthstone to the Broken Tusk, letting you return directly to Orgrimmar. She also sells food, bread, and drink to restore health and mana.

faq.q: Does Gryshka have any connection to the wind rider roost?
faq.answer: Travelers sent on flight errands from the Barrens often bring packages to Gryshka before heading up to Doras, the wind rider master on the mesa above the city.

faq.q: What kind of personality does Gryshka have?
faq.answer: Gryshka is a practical, hearty host who likes good meat, direct talk, and a well-stocked, orderly tavern for the Horde warriors passing through the capital.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler arriving in Durotar, you can bind your hearthstone and resupply at Gryshka's inn in the Valley of Strength before heading deeper into Kalimdor.
As a cook, you can value Gryshka's care in sourcing prime cuts from hunters as far away as the Barrens.
